title: Go invests in AI cybersecurity company Jericho Security
ai_summary: Go Ventures, the venture capital arm of Maltese operator Go, has invested in Jericho Security, a New York-based cybersecurity company that develops AI tools to help organizations protect against social engineering attacks. The financial terms of the investment have not been disclosed. This represents a venture capital deployment by Go into the AI cybersecurity sector, targeting protection against emerging social engineering threats.
